create_reclamation.reclaimer.empty: Reclaimer is empty. Insert a crafted item to dismantle.
create_reclamation.ponder.tag.reclamatio: Dismantle manufactured items into constituent ingredients using Create kinetics.
create_reclamation.ponder.mechanical_rec: The Mechanical Reclaimer dismantles crafted items into their constituent ingredients.
It requires rotational power supplied to its rear shaft socket to operate.
Right-click or supply manufactured items (such as a Mechanical Press) to begin dismantling.
Higher rotational speeds (RPM) accelerate the dismantling process.
Recovered ingredients can be extracted manually or automatically using Create Funnels, Chutes, and Hoppers.
advancement.create_reclamation.root.desc: Obtain a Mechanical Reclaimer to begin recycling manufactured items.
advancement.create_reclamation.salvaged_: Recover Salvaged Scrap from machine deconstruction.
